subject.title: Translate https://crabbox.sh website in multi language

question: Should Crabbox maintain localized documentation now, and should the initial commitment cover a small onboarding-page pilot or the full documentation corpus?
rationale: Locale selection, translation review ownership, fallback behavior, and synchronization policy are continuing product commitments that cannot be inferred safely from this brief request.

options.title: Pilot onboarding pages
options.body: Add locale infrastructure and translate a small set of high-value onboarding pages with English fallback and explicit maintenance checks.

options.title: Localize the full corpus
options.body: Establish translation ownership and continuous synchronization for every documentation page before advertising full multilingual support.

options.title: Remain English-only
options.body: Retain the current site until maintainers have sufficient ownership and capacity for a sustainable translation program.

recommendation.title: Pilot onboarding pages
recommendation.body: Add locale infrastructure and translate a small set of high-value onboarding pages with English fallback and explicit maintenance checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available candidate for deciding Crabbox product and website scope, although file-level ownership evidence could not be recovered in this runtime.
